title: Baker Tilly Warns Clients of Data Breach via Third Party
excerpt: The Baker Tilly Advisory Group is notifying clients about a data breach affecting personal information of clients and dependents.
body_html:
The Baker Tilly Advisory Group has started notifying clients regarding a data breach that exposed personal information belonging to clients and their dependents.

According to the notification sent out by the organization, the security incident originated at a third-party service provider rather than Baker Tilly's own internal systems.

The exposed data includes sensitive personal details. The firm is actively communicating with the affected individuals to provide further information regarding the incident and the third-party involvement.
